name: Livingston County, NY
findings: Livingston County has 192 nonprofit organizations. 98 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 80 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Livingston County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Livingston County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 80 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Livingston County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 7 arts and cultural organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do arts and cultural organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
